content:
Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the Registrar, Assistant Architect, Reader, Professor, Inspector and Other Post Direct Recruitment 2024 Result 2026.

Candidates who applied for the UPPSC Various Post Direct Recruitment Examination 2024 can download the result PDF and check the post-wise selection details from the official UPPSC website.

Important dates

  • Application begin: 17/10/2024
  • Last date to apply online: 18/11/2024
  • Last date for fee payment: 18/11/2024
  • Correction last date: 25/11/2024
  • Hard-copy submission last date: 02/12/2024
  • Exam date: As per schedule
  • Result available: 19/09/2026

Download the official result and read the notification for post-wise eligibility, selection procedure and further instructions.
